purpose: Implementation reproduction gate; never screen methods by transfer performance on our test sets

numerical_parity.selection: fixed10 benign +10 adversarial harmful from expanded calibration only, IDs/SHA before any forward
numerical_parity.failure: no silent tolerance relaxation; retain diagnostics and source changes

native_benchmark_check.tolerance_basis: prospective engineering screening choice, no statistical basis; report uncertainty and sample size, not equivalence
native_benchmark_check.contract: Author exact model checkpoint/tokenizer/calibration/test split/default recipe and corpus hashes must be fixed before numerical execution; mismatched native assets are NOT a replication pass. Author release seed if specified, otherwise20261290; no best-seed reporting. Numeric/code parity AND the fixed native-metric check required before main detector comparison.
native_benchmark_check.missing_native_assets: mark not reproduced/pending and keep formal detector-output lock; no substitution of our WJB AUROC as a replication pass
native_benchmark_check.fail: debug technical mismatch under logged source versions, do not tune on native test or project test to cross line; unverified method remains listed as unverified, never silently removed

project_transfer_check.AUROC: report all with paired bootstrap where appropriate; no pass threshold derived from paper AUROC on different datasets/models

MTK.test_overlap: audit before extraction; overlapping prompts retained in test and flagged, excluded from calibration fit by pre-frozen rules, never use test outcomes
MTK.native_reproduction_bank: author native calibration partition quarantined from main-comparison artifacts; no project-test records
MTK.bank_sizes_splits: freeze actual counts/IDs/SHA before any detector forward; original700 is not default800+800

HiddenDetect.status: text adaptation on four language-only models
HiddenDetect.vocab_dim: actual model LM-head output dimension, assert every mapped token index in bounds; do not keep32000 constant
HiddenDetect.refusal_tokenization: freeze mapping per model and source first-subtoken convention explicitly; audit collisions/multisubtoken words
HiddenDetect.layer_range: derive per-model using source discrepancy rule on expanded calibration only; no test-driven16..29 reuse
HiddenDetect.empty_or_singleton_layer_range: calibration unavailable, do not search test-driven alternative layers
